featuredProject.title: Pilot Project: Tekoá Kuaray Rese
featuredProject.description: Windbreak forest for agroecological protection. The planting of a windbreak forest aims to create a natural protection barrier for food crops in the area. In regions like Osório (RS), this strategy is essential for agricultural, ecological, and climate resilience.
